abstention.policy: accept only if min(selected-candidate desired-sign probability, candidate-set-feasibility probability)>=0.8
abstention.threshold_selection: none; all thresholds fixed now; conditional risk always accompanies coverage
abstention.training: separate L2 logistic direction and feasibility heads, training studies only; rank score alone is not calibrated effect

excluded: N-zip, TDP EV5, reserved SIRLOIN replicate3/4/NucLibB, reserved Arora/Shukla, unadmitted/corrupted sources

gate.benchmark: per held study strongest simple baseline by lowest observed macro regret; ties fewer avoidable failures then lexical; conservative comparator envelope, not a trained model
gate.bootstrap: 5000 Bayesian component bootstrap draws using shared Exponential(1) weights, normalized within each study; one-component studies degenerate; descriptive

labels: within-parent preferences; positive is toward each assay-defined destination; no cross-assay raw-effect pooling
outer_holdout: whole study including all cell/reporters/families; purge all held biological components/exact alleles from every training source
pair_sampling: deterministic uniform unordered pairs without replacement, chosen before labels; every pair has an implicit preference and all pairs enter ordering evaluation
parent_holdout: three fixed component folds; single-component SRLE ineligible; all same-gene and exact allele matches co-grouped
preference_ties: truth ties omitted; prediction ties half credit; lexical candidate ties for selection
primary_metric: equal-study, equal biological-component, equal parent/context/direction normalized selected-candidate regret
scaler: training-only weighted mean/std; zero variance scale1

secondary.domain: projection versus nuclear; no outcome-derived reorientation
secondary.family: same endpoint class only; no eligible source for held SRLE within core, report ineligible
secondary.locality: span<=6 sensitivity, fixed predictions only; candidate sets must retain >=2 distinct outcomes
secondary.pretrained: frozen cached 3UTRBERT pooled allele delta; restricted two-study Mikl/Moffatt comparison on identical complete-context covered rows; no zero filling or absent-encoder substitution
secondary.sirloin: discovery replicate1/2 only, no training in primary study grid

selection.none_pass: NO-GO; no new dataset discovery; no final generalizable deployment model
selection.tie: within1e-12 fewer features, then lexical name

weights: equal study, then connected gene/exact-allele component, then parent-context, then sampled preference
